name: @ably/text-decoder
description: A light-weight TextDecoder polyfill for React Native Hermes that only supports utf-8

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:types
scripts.build:cjs: tsc --project tsconfig.cjs.json && mv build/cjs/index.js build/index.cjs && rm -rf build/cjs
scripts.build:types: tsc --project tsconfig.types.json && cp build/types/index.d.ts build/index.d.ts && cp build/types/index.d.ts build/index.d.cts && rm -rf build/types

author: Ably
